page_title: OVI 1-2 ELC | Oviedo v Elche 26/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' German Valera (Elche) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90+3' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+2' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

90+1' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Matias Dituro pulls off an easy save.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
88' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
87' Oviedo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
85' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) whips the ball into the box and Federico Vinas takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
84' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
82' Here is a change. Buba Sangare is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Victor Chust (Elche).
82' Adria Pedrosa will be replaced by Leo Petrot (Elche).
80' The resulting set piece from Oviedo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' 1 - 2 Goal! Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
78' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
76' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
76' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves prepares a substitution. Nicolas Fonseca is replaced by Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo).
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and German Valera (Elche) replaces Andre Silva.
69' Today's match ends for Marc Aguado who will be replaced by John Donald (Elche).
66' Aleix Febas (Elche) is able to continue to play.
65' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) replaces David Carmo.
63' Looks like Aleix Febas (Elche) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
63' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' Hector Fort goes off the pitch and Tete Morente (Elche) comes on.
62' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
58' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves decides to make a substitution. Haissem Hassan will be replaced by Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo).
58' It's time for a substitution. Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) comes on in place of Rahim Alhassane.
58' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
57' The ball is out of play. Oviedo will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
53' Buba Sangare (Elche) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
53' Aleix Febas (Elche) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
51' It looks like Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) saw red with that tackle. Jose Sanchez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
50' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
50' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
48' The attendance for today's match is 25615.
46' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has made a change at the break. Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) has come on in place of Kwasi Sibo.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Oviedo fail to score from a corner as Matias Dituro (Elche) leaps to collect the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The game is interrupted. Buba Sangare (Elche) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
43' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) makes a strong challenge and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
41' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
38' Wonderful movement by Elche. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
32' The shot by Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Matias Dituro.
30' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
30' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Oviedo will take a corner kick.
26' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' Oviedo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
16' 0 - 2 Gonzalo Villar (Elche) scores an easy goal. He receives a precise pass inside the box and sends the ball past the goalkeeper, glancing in off the downside of the left post.
12' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but Matias Dituro comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) trips an opposition player and Jose Sanchez signals a foul.
10' Buba Sangare (Elche) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

6' 0 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Pedro Bigas (Elche). He perfectly collected a pass from Marc Aguado, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the top right corner. The score is 0:1.
2' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
